objective: The owner's request of 2026-11-24 (the first step of sub-goal B325 only; goals G5 with G18): on the structures already built, search for pairs of knots that agree on everything within d holder steps but differ in who their parents are, for d from 1 to 6. Stop at a rule that recovers the parents on every structure reached, or at a pair no bounded reading tells apart. Usual standard: a frozen pre-registration reviewed cold by the advisor, code written from the frozen text and checked, the knot test on any structure grown for the search, every choice named as a scaffold.
title: Can a knot tell its parents from its children by what is built around it?
